notes:
## 2.7.4

- Update recommended settings to match optimized personal settings: crosshair, FOV, team colors, teammate HP, unit GUI scale, WSI scale, objective beam, auto queue, skip intro, disable main menu frame cap

## 2.7.3

- Performance optimization: event-driven healthbar update skip — healthbar population only updates when HP actually changes, eliminating per-frame scanning
- Add GuiFrontPlayers throttle (teammate world-space indicators, every 6 frames)
- Recommended settings now enable performance optimization by default
- Fix damage numbers floating on first hit to a device

## 2.7.2

- Performance optimization: minimap, gravity trap, fan animator, and WSI team overlay updates throttled to reduce CPU usage on device-heavy maps
- Removed diagnostic/experimental mode UI from performance settings
- Removed Ability Cast experimental feature

## 2.7.1

- Fixed damage numbers floating/sticking to screen when devices take damage
- Device healthbar performance optimization: 33% FPS improvement (416 → 554 avg) with health-state culling

## 2.7.0

- Added no-Steam setup flow: users without Block N Load in their Steam library can now download and install the game directly from the launcher
- Game download with live progress (file count tracking during extraction)
- "I already have the files" path for users who downloaded manually
- MEGA mirror links shown as fallback (ZIP, 7z, and audio dependencies)
- Audio dependencies download option for users with no in-game sound
- No-Steam installs bypass Steam process checks at launch
